verses.gurmukhi: ਕੇਵਡੁ ਤੋਲੁ ਸੰਜੋਗੁ ਦਾ ਕੇਵਡੁ ਤੋਲੁ ਵਿਜੋਗੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ।
verses.translit_en: kevadd tol sa(n)jog dhaa kevadd tol vijog veechaaraa|

en.bdb: How to think about the periphery of meeting (Sanjog) and separation (vijog), because meeting and separation is part of a continuous process among the creatures.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕੇਵਡੁ ਹਸਣੁ ਆਖੀਐ ਕੇਵਡੁ ਰੋਵਣ ਦਾ ਬਿਸਥਾਰਾ।
verses.translit_en: kevadd hasan aakheeaai kevadd rovan dhaa bisathaaraa|

en.bdb: What is laughing and what are the limits of weeping and wailing?

verses.gurmukhi: ਕੇਵਡੁ ਹੈ ਨਿਰਵਿਰਤਿ ਪਖੁ ਕੇਵਡੁ ਹੈ ਪਰਵਿਰਤਿ ਪਸਾਰਾ।
verses.translit_en: kevadd hai niravirat pakh kevadd hai paravirat pasaaraa|

en.bdb: How to tell the perimeter of indulgence and repudiation?

verses.gurmukhi: ਕੇਵਡੁ ਆਖਾ ਪੁੰਨ ਪਾਪੁ ਕੇਵਡੁ ਆਖਾ ਮੋਖੁ ਦੁਆਰਾ।
verses.translit_en: kevadd aakhaa pu(n)n paap kevadd aakhaa mokh dhuaaraa|

en.bdb: How to describe the virtue, sin and the doors of liberation.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕੇਵਡੁ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਆਖੀਐ ਇਕਦੂੰ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਲਖ ਅਪਾਰਾ।
verses.translit_en: kevadd kudharat aakheeaai ikadhoo(n) kudharat lakh apaaraa|

en.bdb: Nature is indescribable because in it one extends to millions and millions.

verses.gurmukhi: ਦਾਨੈ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਾ ਪਵੈ ਕੇਵਡੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਦੇਵਣਹਾਰਾ।
verses.translit_en: dhaanai keemat naa pavai kevadd dhaataa dhevanahaaraa|

en.bdb: The evaluation of that (great) Giver cannot be done and nothing can be told about His expansion.
His ineffable story, beyond all bases is always unmanifest.
